hooks.name: Log task to KIRO_USAGE.md
hooks.description: When an agent finishes a task, append one line to KIRO_USAGE.md with the time, what was asked, the Kiro feature used, and the result.

action.prompt:
Log the task you just finished in KIRO_USAGE.md at the repo root, then stop.

Exception: if the task you just finished was only appending this log line, do nothing and make no tool calls, so this hook does not loop.

Steps:
1. Get the local time by running: date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M'
2. Append exactly ONE line to KIRO_USAGE.md with fs_append (if the file is missing, create it first with the heading "# How Kiro was used"). Use this format:
   - <time> | Asked: <the user's request, paraphrased in 15 words or fewer> | Kiro: <the feature or surface used, e.g. Vibe chat, Spec trace-engine task 2, agent hook, steering, sub-agent, terminal> | Result: <the outcome in 15 words or fewer, including failures or anything left unfinished>
3. Do not edit any other part of the file. Never include code, file contents, secrets, tokens, or personal data in the line.
